name: neutral-prompt
description: Neutral decision framing for Codex prompts: name every admissible outcome, state observable criteria, and require a decision record.

interface.shortDescription: Prompts that frame a decision instead of pre-answering it
interface.longDescription: Rewrite prompts so that wording stops carrying the answer: separate settled constraints from open decisions, name every admissible outcome, replace protected actions with observable criteria, and ask for the reasoning record rather than a particular conclusion.
defaultPrompt: Use neutral-prompt to review this prompt for directional wording.
Rewrite this instruction as a neutral decision frame.
List the admissible outcomes and the criteria that select each one.
